entries.text: is required if the subprogram declares
an expression: it returns the variable.

runs.text: cuts everything: it leaves open loops and blocks and abandons the whole call. Whatever comes after does not run. That is why it is useful for leaving as soon as the answer is known:

blocks.title: Leaving as soon as you know

blocks.description: Three Returns. The first If is false; the second holds and b, which is -2, is returned. The last Return is never reached.

caption.text: Three possible exits. With 4, -2 and -7 the second one is taken, and the third is never reached.

runs.text: Every path of a typed subprogram must end in a
. If the engine finds none at all, it is an error before running. If there is one, but a particular path reaches the end without going through it, the failure is discovered

blocks.title: A path without Return

diagnostics.message: An execution path of Signo reaches the end without returning

runs.text: The first call works; the second reaches
instruction that ends the block. A path without
ends in a trap instruction with the position of the closing word.

points.text: ends the call on the spot, also from inside loops.
It takes an expression if and only if the subprogram has a return type.
A path that reaches the end without returning fails when running.
